notes.title: Update #1 - Some Fixes for Jump Limit and Others
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Some of the issues have been fixed with this update. 

1. There should have been a jump limit of 5000 times but for some reason, it was just allowing the player to jump only 5 times. 
With this update, this issue has been successfully fixed. 

2. Some minor bugs have been fixed and any further bugs will be fixed based on the community feedback.

I would like to clarify some information related to red, blue and green stars which you collect in some levels. There are no separate numbers for blue and green stars since they are added to the main score of the game.

For instance, if you receive a yellow star, you get 5 scores. If you receive a red star you get 200 scores, for a blue star, you receive 1000 scores and for the green star, you receive 500 scores. 

That means, whichever star you collect in the process the value is added to your total score.  The achievements will pop up only when you collect blue, red and green stars for the first time. 

I hope it helps. Please download the updated version through your Steam client and enjoy the game.
